privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Algfolded is a trainer for blindfolded speedcubing. This page explains what data comes up along the way, what it is used for and how to get rid of it. The guiding principle: as little as possible, and nothing is ever sold or used for advertising.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The party responsible for data processing on this website is:

logs.title: Visiting the site
logs.body: When you open the site your browser sends technically necessary information to the hosting provider: IP address, timestamp, the resource requested, browser and operating system identifiers and the referring page. These server logs occur whenever a website is operated, serve only operations and security, and are not combined with any other data.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: Visitor statistics are collected with Vercel Web Analytics. It measures page views, approximate region, device type, browser and referring page. It sets no cookies and neither stores nor reads any data in your browser. Repeat visits are not linked across websites; visitors are counted server-side using a one-way checksum that is rotated regularly. No personal profiles are created.

localstorage.title: Local storage in your browser
localstorage.body: Your settings stay local to your browser (localStorage) and are not sent to the server unless you are signed in. This covers language, colour scheme, selected cases, presets, custom algorithms, letter scheme, notes and your times. You can clear it at any time through your browser settings, after which the site starts fresh.
localstorage.note: This storage is necessary for the functionality you requested and therefore needs no separate consent.

account.title: Signing in with a WCA account
account.body: Signing in is optional and exists so your times can sync across devices. It runs through the official OAuth service of the World Cube Association; no password is ever passed to Algfolded. Once signed in, the following is stored:
account.item_wca_id: the public WCA ID, where one exists
account.item_name: the name held in the WCA account
account.item_avatar: the address of the WCA profile picture
account.after: Without signing in none of this is collected, and the application remains fully usable.

solves.title: Stored times
solves.body: While signed in, your training results are stored against your account: algorithm set, case, time in milliseconds, scramble, algorithm used and timestamp. This data serves only your own statistics and is not shown to anyone else.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Exactly one cookie is set, and only if you sign in: a session identifier that keeps you signed in. It is protected against access by scripts, expires at the end of the session and is removed when you sign out. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.

processors.title: Service providers involved
processors.body: Running the site requires third parties that technically process the data described above:
processors.item_frontend: Hosting of the website and its interfaces, and audience measurement:
processors.item_wca: Sign-in: World Cube Association, only when you actively use the login.
processors.note: Hosting in the USA means data may be processed outside Switzerland and the EEA; the provider commits to an adequate level of protection through standard contractual clauses.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: Account and timing data are kept until you ask for deletion. Sessions expire automatically. Statistics data is not personal in the first place. On request your account and all associated times will be deleted in full; write to the address below.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to the data held about you, have it corrected or deleted, restrict its processing and request it in a common format. An informal message to the contact address is enough. If you believe your data is not being processed lawfully, you may contact the competent supervisory authority.

contact.title: Contact

nature.title: About this project
nature.body: Algfolded is a non-commercial hobby project. It is free to use, no goods or services are sold, and no advertising is served.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Content is produced with care but without warranty as to accuracy or completeness. The operators of external sites are solely responsible for their content; no infringements were apparent at the time the links were added.
